fields.help: Pagination behavior of the listManagedInstances API method for this managed instance group.

fields.label: Name
fields.help: The name of the instance group manager.

fields.label: Project
fields.help: The ID of the project in which the resource belongs.

fields.label: Target Pools
fields.help: The full URL of all target pools to which new instances in the group are added.

fields.label: Target Size
fields.help: The target number of running instances for this managed instance group.

fields.label: Target Stopped Size
fields.help: The target number of stopped instances for this managed instance group.

fields.label: Target Suspended Size
fields.help: The target number of suspended instances for this managed instance group.

Health Check

fields.label: Instance Lifecycle Policy

fields.help: Specifies whether to apply the group's latest configuration when repairing a VM.

fields.help: Specifies the action that a MIG performs on an unhealthy VM.

Configuration for VM repairs in the MIG.

Name

fields.help: The port number.

Resource policies for this managed instance group.

fields.help: Specifies the number of seconds that the MIG should wait to suspend or stop a VM after that VM was created.

Standby policy for stopped and suspended instances.

Disks created on the instances that will be preserved on instance delete, update, etc.

fields.help: The network interface name

fields.help: Specifies a percentage of instances between 0 to 100%, inclusive.

fields.label: Max Unavailable Fixed

fields.label: Max Unavailable Percent
fields.help: Specifies a percentage of instances between 0 to 100%, inclusive.
